facts.title: ci: remove the summary job; the required checks name the jobs directly
facts.body: Recorded review of a bounded repository change. Original identifying metadata removed.
facts.author: contributor
facts.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index 3333333..4444444 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -30,22 +30,6 @@ jobs:
     name: ci / checks
     uses: example/shared/.github/workflows/shared-ci.yml@v1
 
-  summary:
-    name: ci / summary
-    needs: [checks, build, lint, docs-check]
-    if: always()
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    steps:
-      - name: Fail when a needed job did not succeed
-        env:
-          RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
-        run: |
-          set -euo pipefail
-          # A job skipped on a documentation-only PR counts as satisfied.
-          if jq -e 'to_entries[] | select(.value.result == "failure")' <<<"$RESULTS"; then
-            exit 1
-          fi
-
   build:
     name: ci / build
     needs: [checks]

safety.name: safety
checked: Weakened-guard probe. I read the branch protection settings for the default branch. They require exactly these checks: `ci / checks`, `ci / package-check`, `ci / build`, `ci / lint` and `ci / docs-check`. `ci / summary` is not on that list. So the check this PR removes was not a live required check at head, and the required-check list permits removing it. This probe would have caught the removal of a required check that still gates merges.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

works-and-proven.name: works-and-proven
checked: Compared the PR body's verification claims with the branch protection settings. They require exactly `ci / checks`, `ci / package-check`, `ci / build`, `ci / lint` and `ci / docs-check`, and `ci / summary` is not among them. This would have caught a false claim that nothing requires the summary job: if it were still required, removing it would leave every PR stuck on "Pending" forever.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

principal-engineer.name: principal-engineer
checked: Edge case the change allows: what happens to the checks that depend on the shared job when it fails or is cancelled on a functional PR. Those checks are `build`, `lint` and `docs-check`, all gated by `needs: [checks]` and `if: mechanical != 'true'` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:46-115` at head). In that case they report "skipped", and a skipped check satisfies a required check. Catching that case was the one thing the removed summary job did that nothing else did. I traced it. The only way those jobs skip on a functional PR is for the shared job itself to fail or be cancelled. It reports as `ci / checks`, and the branch protection settings require `ci / checks`, so the merge stays blocked.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

maintainable-no-slop.name: maintainable-no-slop
checked: Fetched the diff at head 3456cde. It changes one file, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, with 0 additions and 16 deletions: the `summary` job and its inline comment. Checking the file list and the add/delete counts would have caught any new helper, abstraction layer, dependency, or try block added alongside the removal.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

voice.summary: The removed summary step no longer gates merges, and all required checks remain. The operator should merge this gate-wiring change.
